status: Integrated on 24 October 2026 (backlog 156): src/lib/agronomy.ts CROPS, landCrops.ts SOWING/SALT, localAnswer.ts aliases and planting months. scripts/verify-new-crops.ts keeps the code equal to this file.

method.rule: Every figure is read off a cited published table or text. A crop with any of growing days, water need (Kc), salt tolerance or a Sudanese sowing month unsourced is excluded.
method.fao56: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Chapter 6, Tables 11 and 12: https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm
method.fao29: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 29 Rev.1 (Ayers & Westcot 1985), Tables 4 and 5: https://www.fao.org/4/t0234e/T0234E03.htm
method.reading_caveat: fao.org was blocked from this container's shell. Table rows were read from the web-conversion of the FAO page (which drops merged/blank cells and the whole Kc_ini column of Table 12) and from the PDF edition of the same paper (a copy hosted at cse.iitb.ac.in), which keeps the row structure. Kc_mid and Kc_end were checked in both; Kc_ini and the merged Table 11 rows rest on the PDF text.
method.range_rule: Where Table 12 prints a range: footnote's own rule if there is one (cowpea Kc_end dry = 0.35; sunflower and safflower Kc_mid irrigated = 1.15); otherwise the midpoint (rice Kc_end 0.75), as the repo did for cotton and sorghum.
method.kc_ini_rule: Table 12's own value for the crop, else its group header's value.
method.month0: 0 = January. First month of the published sowing window for the season the FAO row best matches.
method.extension_portal_caveat: Where the source is senassudan.com (a Sudan agricultural extension portal), the page does not name its publisher; marked in each crop's flags.
method.salt_rule: ece is FAO-29 Table 4's ECe for 100% yield where the table has the crop; null where only Table 5 gives a class.

flags: Table 11 / Table 12 rows were read from the PDF edition of FAO-56 (copy at cse.iitb.ac.in) and cross-checked against the FAO HTML page for Kc_mid/Kc_end; fao.org itself was not reachable from this container, and the HTML conversion I could read drops the Kc_ini column and some Table 11 cells.
Sowing source is an extension bulletin on senassudan.com (Sudan agricultural extension portal; the page does not name its publisher). Treat as extension-level, not peer-reviewed.

PERENNIAL. month0 is the orchard planting month for grapefruit in the source, not the start of a seasonal cycle. Table 11 itself starts its 365-day citrus cycle in January. Over a full 365-day cycle the annual total does not depend on the start month, but the monthly split does.

The Sudanese source covers grapefruit only; the other citrus (orange, lemon, mandarin) have no sowing sentence in the sources found. FAO-29 lists all of them as Sensitive, so the class holds across citrus; the ece figure is grapefruit's.
Kc row chosen: no ground cover, 70% canopy (mature orchard). Table 12 notes 21-22: increase by 0.1-0.2 in humid/sub-humid climates; not applied for arid Sudan.
Like date palm in the repo, the stage split is Table 11's own, but the cycle is annual, not planting-to-harvest.

excluded.reason: No FAO-56 Table 11 row (Table 11 legumes list beans, faba bean, cowpea, groundnut, lentil, peas, soybeans only), so there are no stage lengths. Table 12 has Kc (0.4/1.00/0.35) but a crop needs both. Chickpea is also absent from FAO-29 Tables 4 and 5.

FAO-56 is complete (Table 11 'Oct/Nov, Arid Region' 25/35/70/40 = 170 d; Table 12 0.4/1.10/0.30), but no source with a lentil sowing month in Sudan was found (the Sudanese lentil papers found describe weed control and yield without stating the month), and lentil is not in FAO-29 Tables 4 and 5.
FAO-56 Table 12 has garlic (Kc mid 1.00, end 0.70) but Table 11 has no garlic row, so no stage lengths. Also not in FAO-29 Tables 4 and 5. No Sudan sowing source gathered.

Not pursued: not a major Sudanese crop, and no Sudanese sowing source was gathered. (FAO-56 and FAO-29 do list it: Table 11 'June, Pakistan, Calif.' 15/25/35/20 = 95 d; Table 12 0.4/1.15/0.35; ECe 1.0, class S.) Cowpea covers the Sudanese bean crop.
